entities.name: Fineza Eusébio
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Fineza da Silva Eusébio is an Angolan basketball player. At the 2012 Summer Olympics, she competed for the Angola women's national basketball team in the women's event. She is 5 ft 10 inches tall.
